title: Research on Health Effects of N-Nitrosamine
summary: Investigating the presence, exposure pathways, and public health implications of N-nitrosamine compounds in drinking water systems.
body: This project examines the formation of N-nitrosamine compounds during water treatment and their downstream health effects on exposed populations. Field sampling, laboratory analysis, and epidemiological review are combined to assess risk and inform treatment guidelines.

title: Model and Predict Disease
summary: Building predictive models linking environmental exposure data to disease incidence.
body: Using statistical and machine learning approaches, this project develops models that predict disease outbreak risk from environmental and water quality indicators, supporting early public health intervention.

title: Create and Deploy Sensors
summary: Designing low-cost environmental sensors for field deployment across monitoring sites.
body: This project develops and field-tests low-cost sensor units for continuous water quality and environmental monitoring, with a focus on durability and affordability for deployment across distributed sites.

title: Measure and Destroy Hazards
summary: Developing measurement and remediation techniques for environmental hazards.
body: Combining field measurement techniques with remediation technology development, this project targets the detection and safe elimination of environmental contaminants of concern.
